instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: The louder the support, the more attention it gets. When the star of the show steps into the spotlight, the audience watches more closely. Will people think, must support it, so we can relax? Or, wait, let's check the details. What matters is not how loud the support is, it is how others respond. To begin, special committees at both companies are there to review the merger. Setting them up does not mean the merger is approved. In other words, they have only put out chairs for a meeting to review it. It is too early to set off the party poppers.
